stdout:
Create a comment. Use this tool to create a comment on a video.

Usage:
  yutu comment insert [flags]

Examples:
# Reply to a comment
yutu comment insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9 --authorChannelId UA_x5X --parentId UgyXXX --textOriginal 'Hello'
# Reply with rating enabled
yutu comment insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9 --authorChannelId UA_x5X --parentId UgyXXX --textOriginal 'Reply' --canRate

Flags:
  -a, --authorChannelId string   Channel id of the comment author
  -R, --canRate                  Whether the viewer can rate the comment
  -c, --channelId string         Channel id of the video owner
  -h, --help                     help for insert
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|silent
  -P, --parentId string          ID of the parent comment
  -t, --textOriginal string      Text of the comment
  -v, --videoId string           ID of the video
      --yes                      Confirm the operation
